name: music-api
description: FastAPI Music API with YouTube, JioSaavn and Telegram cache

BASE_DIR.description: Optional base directory. Leave empty on Heroku to use /app; VPS can use /home/ubuntu.

YTDLP_BIN.description: Optional yt-dlp executable path. Leave empty when yt-dlp is in PATH.

DENO_BIN.description: Optional Deno executable path. Leave empty when deno is in PATH.

NODE_BIN.description: Optional Node executable path. Leave empty when node is in PATH.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat/channel ID used for media cache

API_MASTER.description: Master password for API key management
